primaryChecks.text: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
primaryChecks.previousContext: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
primaryChecks.nextContext: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: エフライムの所有地・居住地の列挙で東側の町として明記。
